name: web_search
description: Search the web. Tries DuckDuckGo Lite first and silently falls back to Bing Search when DDG is unreachable, serving its bot-challenge page, or returns nothing. No API key needed. Input: {"query": "...", "max_results": 1-20 (default 8), "region": "optional, e.g. en-US"}. Returns {"ok": true, "backend": "duckduckgo"|"bing", "query": "...", "count": N, "results": [{"title", "url", "snippet"}]}.

max_results.description: How many results to return (1-20, default 8)

region.description: Region/locale hint, e.g. "en-US"; passed to the Bing fallback as market and language (DuckDuckGo ignores it)
